# 3 bed semi-detached house for sale

> No. 18 Meadow Park is a spacious and well-presented three-bedroom semi-detached home offering comfortable family living in a peaceful village setting. Situated within a mature residential development, this attractive home combines bright, well-proportioned accommodation with a private rear garden and a charming conservatory, creating an ideal space for modern family life .
